name: Unbounded Loop Denial of Service
threat_model: A permissionless registrant grows the payee list until a distribution loop exceeds the block gas budget and can no longer progress.
assumptions: Payee registration is permissionless in the vulnerable example.
The attack is about gas-scaled liveness and does not require stealing funds.
The remediated example uses bounded crediting batches and independent pull claims.
invariant: Untrusted growth in payee state cannot make another payee's distribution or withdrawal permanently unreachable.

detector_expectations.expectation: the relevant gas-growth and withdrawal-liveness property is verified by tests
